svg.title: One edited trajectory, two placements
svg.desc: Common-scale cropped detail of the actual edited wide plan at three seconds. The actual studio Before places labels above their markers; Alpha and Beta envelopes overlap. Compiled offsets separate the labels. World curves and time are identical. This illustration is not the continuous verification.

g.text: Keep the path. Move the label.
Alpha control y: 2 → 3/2. Every other source field is retained.
The solver checks the complete 0–6 s interval; these two drawings show only t = 3 s.
